title: Who came back?

options.text: The badge proves Mara herself returned.
An authentic account does not prove who operates it.
Mara must be dead or replaced.

feedback: These sources limit what verification proves. They do not establish death, reconstruction or the current operator.

title: What was commissioned?

options.text: The invoice alone proves every detail.
The matching project ties the returned account to a commissioned reconstruction.
The records prove the presence has no consciousness.

feedback: Match service and commission project. That establishes the commissioned return, not consciousness or culpability.

title: What would proof expose?

options.text: The trace proves where Mara lives now.
A limited private lead could invite a search; present whereabouts remain unknown.
The name on the slip independently confirms Mara’s identity.

feedback: Testimony and a redacted association support a limited lead. They do not establish current location or a confirmed alias.
